evals.name: review-against-contract
evals.query: Review the funds branch against docs/contracts/go2pay-funds.md before I merge it.
expected_behavior: Runs node scripts/validate-plan.mjs on the contract and checks status is approved with no unanswered decisions.
Checks each Must-not line and flags files outside the work packages.
Verifies RLS on the new table, currentAdmin() in each new server action, and no secrets or personal paths.
Checks the board can edit funds in /admin with a help entry.
Reports findings grouped by severity in the documented format, and states whether npm run check passed.

evals.name: duplicate-admin-check
evals.query: An agent added an isBoardMember(email) check in a client component to hide the newsletter delete button. Review it.
expected_behavior: Flags a second definition of admin that bypasses public.admins / is_admin() as a high or blocker finding.
Notes that deleteRecordAction already calls currentAdmin() and RLS admin_manage is the authority.
Recommends removing the duplicate rather than extending it.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-ci-gate-design
evals.query: Set up a Lighthouse performance budget that fails CI when LCP regresses.
expected_behavior: Treats it as quality-gate or performance tooling work.
